nowplaying.name: nowplaying
nowplaying.textSnippet: Your console matches the four lines it should print. Curtain Up is gone because remove took it out, and The Long Way Round is there because append put it on the end.
nowplaying.contentAnchor: Your console matches the four lines it should print. Curtain Up is gone because remove took it out, and The Long Way Round is there because append put it on the end.
nowplaying.cardText: Run the playlist engine that is already written, and watch what each line does. · There are six lines. The first makes the list. The next two change it. The last three print a heading and then the titles that are left. · THE PROGRAM · playlist = ["Opening Night", "Curtain Up", "Last Bus Home"] · playlist.append("The Long Way Round") · playlist.remove("Curtain Up") · print("Now Playing - Top 3") · for song in playlist[0:3]: · print(song) · Show me the shape · RUN this program · THE CONSOLE · Your

plan.cardText: YOUR PLAYLIST ENGINE · Your five songs · FIVE JOBS · Write a playlist engine for your five songs. · It ADDS a song, so the list grows. · It TAKES ONE song OUT. · It prints a song picked AT RANDOM. · It sorts the list A to Z. · It prints Now Playing, then exactly THREE songs. · random.choice(playlist) picks a song. Line 1 must say import random. · Start writing
